data.gender_notes: Chetanaanand is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Chetana refers to consciousness or awareness, and Anand means bliss. This name signifies the awareness of one's own inner bliss. The name Chetanaanand carries the meaning “Awareness with Bliss” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chetanaanand usually hope their child will grow to embody awareness with bliss and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chetanaanand belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Awareness with Bliss.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chetanaanand total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
